arrival.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - FlixBus Route 802 (direction Amsterdam Sloterdijk). Departs Bruges Station 16:10, arrives Amsterdam Sloterdijk (Platform Zone 1, Piarcoplein, 1043 DW Amsterdam) at 20:20 (~4h10m). Seat 20C. Price 22.48 EUR. From Sloterdijk to Onefam Amstel (Sarphatipark 58): consider tram/metro or taxi (~20-25 min, 25-35 EUR by taxi/Uber). Alternative from Schiphol Airport (if flying in instead): train to Amsterdam Zuid (7-10 min) then Tram 5 or 12 to Museumplein/Van Baerlestraat, then 5-10 min walk.

departure.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - Super Sparpreis Europa (2nd class), non-refundable, seat-bound to ICE 141. Departs Amsterdam Centraal 05:45, arrives Berlin Hbf 12:50 (~7h05m via Hengelo/Bad Bentheim/Osnabrück/Hannover/Berlin route). Seat: Wagon 24, Seat 34 (mobile phone zone), reservation 805600008509. Price: 65.49 EUR. Ticket valid 28.10.2026 00:00 - 30.10.2026 03:00. Very early departure — checkout from Onefam Amstel (11:00 deadline) is irrelevant here; must leave hostel by ~04:50 to reach Amsterdam Centraal in time. Confirm night porter/early checkout availability with hostel in advance. Bring printed or app-loaded ticket + photo ID.

activities.notes: ~3.5 km from De Pijp to Centraal. Night buses run in Amsterdam but check schedule - taxi/Uber (~15-20 EUR) is safest bet for a guaranteed on-time arrival at this hour.

research_notes.notes: Very tight/early morning departure - confirm hostel allows quiet early checkout, and consider booking a taxi the night before for guaranteed on-time arrival.

must_try_dishes.description: Two thin waffle layers with a caramel syrup filling - best fresh and warm from a market stall (Albert Cuyp Market is famous for this).
Deep-fried breaded balls filled with a thick meat ragout, served with mustard. Classic Dutch bar snack.
Raw, lightly salted herring, traditionally eaten plain or with onions and pickles, often from a street stall.
Thick-cut Dutch fries, traditionally served 'met' (with mayonnaise), or with peanut sauce/onions (patat speciaal/oorlog).
Dense, cinnamon-spiced apple pie, usually served warm with whipped cream (slagroom) at a cafe.
Small, fluffy pancakes served with butter and powdered sugar - a popular sweet snack.

drinks_and_rituals.description: Heineken and Amstel are both Amsterdam-born, but look for local craft breweries too. Often served with a generous foam head.
The precursor to modern gin, traditionally served chilled in a small tulip-shaped glass, often at a proeverij (tasting house).

restaurants.name: Albert Cuyp Market Food Stalls
restaurants.notes: Amsterdam's largest and most famous street market - great for a casual, cheap meal while browsing.

restaurants.name: Foodhallen
restaurants.notes: Trendy indoor food market in a converted tram depot - great variety under one roof.

restaurants.name: Winkel 43
restaurants.notes: Widely regarded as having the best apple pie in Amsterdam - expect a queue, especially on weekends.

special_meal_formats: Rijsttafel (Indonesian 'rice table') - a multi-dish Indonesian feast, a legacy of Dutch colonial history, typically 25-40 EUR per person at a dedicated Indonesian restaurant
tourist_traps_to_avoid: Restaurants directly on Damrak or around Dam Square - inflated prices for mediocre, tourist-oriented food
'Dutch Pancake House' chains near major landmarks - better and cheaper pancake spots exist a few streets away
